plainText:
Sophocles's parents are recurring characters who appeared in . Sophocles's father is vice-president of the Alola tourism center.

==History==
=== ===
Sophocles's parents debuted in A Guardian Rematch!. They live in a house in Hau'oli City together with their son. brought home with him and introduced him to them.

In Alolan Open House!, they visited Sophocles at the Pokémon School as part of the Visiting Day. They were seen chatting with .

In So Long, Sophocles!, they informed Sophocles that they were moving house. Sophocles feared that this meant moving to another island when in fact they were just moving a few houses away.

Sophocles's mother reappeared in The Dex Can't Help It!, where she found Sophocles frozen by when it took on the form of .

In Rise and Shine, Starship!, they were camping with Sophocles at Bamboo Hill when he encountered a . They were later seen delivering Sophocles a late-night snack, only to see him engrossed in his research.

Sophocles's father briefly appeared in A Young Royal Flame Ignites!, where he was watching the Battle Royal along with Sophocles.

Sophocles's mother appeared during a flashback in Filling the Light with Darkness!, where Sophocles revealed that she had been sleeping due to the effects of a .

In Lillier and the Staff!, they watched Sophocles perform in the school play.

Sophocles's father briefly reappeared again in Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!, where he was watching Kahili play a round of PokéGolf on TV.

In The Road to The Semifinals!, Sophocles's parents watched their son's battle against in the Manalo Conference on TV. Though Sophocles lost, his parents praised his effort and decided to have a malasada party when he returned home.

==Character==
Sophocles's parents are supportive of their son, evidenced by the fact that they built a lab for Sophocles to use. Sophocles's mother is also a good cook, as he would make positive comments about her homemade malasada.

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
Dub closed captions refer to them as Sophocles' mother and Sophocles' father‬.

==Related articles==
